title: Le Domaine de Hương (Trang viên tri thức · Knowledge Manor): an interactive 3D scene of a scholar's estate
description:
An interactive 3D scene that runs entirely in the browser and makes no network request at all. A visitor walks, cycles or paddles a sampan through a Mekong-Delta estate belonging to a doctoral researcher. Everything is drawn at run time from code; there is no game engine, no build step and no server-side component.

Eight themed zones — research, library, music, storytelling, news, the main house, the lantern path and a future store. Each zone has its own silhouette: the enclosure may be a ring, three straight sides or absent entirely, and each carries a distinct vertical landmark (a square tower, an A-frame, a raised stilt roof, a stage arch, a flagpole, a lantern row, a mast) so the zones can be told apart from across the estate.

Four lighting states — morning, afternoon, night and a noir mode — each with its own sun, sky and rim-light ratio, shadow frame and fog distance. A survey camera orbits the whole estate on a long lens, clearing the clouds and widening the shadow frame so the composition still holds.

Three ways to travel. On foot, by bicycle, or by sampan — and the sampan is confined to the river, tested against the polygon of the water surface itself rather than against a copied formula, so it never ends up on the grass.

Five gameplay modules — achievements, side quests, a play loop, a mini-game and a story quest — all of which redraw their text at the moment of painting, so a visitor who switches language mid-session sees the open panel redrawn correctly.

Narration in the author's own recorded voice, in Vietnamese and English; English is the default and the visitor's choice is remembered.

No network calls, measured rather than promised: no script or stylesheet loaded from outside the repository, no run-time network call, no outgoing request after load (measured in Chromium), and no analytics, advertising or third-party cookies.

Live version: thuyhuongctu.github.io/Le-Domaine-de-Huong
